title: Request
description: The frontmatter of a request (Rq): one thing the pilot asks the commander to approve, deny or change, boiled down from a dossier. Filed by identifier alone, Rq013.md.

type.description: the word Request, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this request's identifier, Rq and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

status.description: where the request stands with the commander: open, approved, denied, amended or withdrawn

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

work.description: the mission this request belongs to, M and three digits

context.description: the identifiers this request comes out of, a bracketed list; a request's context is its dossier, Ds and three digits

generates.description: the identifiers of what this request led to, a bracketed list, usually a decision or an advice file
